name: Coromandel Engineering Company Limited
about: Coromandel Engineering Company Limited engages in the construction and property development businesses in India. It designs and develops residential flats; roads and drainage systems to public utilities; industrial units and factory spaces; and commercial projects, including office complexes, retail outlets, and mixed-use developments, as well as farmland and sites, resorts and clubs. The company also provides farming, rural housing, and project management solutions; operates a marketplace for construction raw materials, tools, and essential building supplies; rents construction, industrial, and agricultural equipment; and machinery rental services. Coromandel Engineering Company Limited was incorporated in 1947 and is based in Chennai, India.
